root.label: Vocabulary types and format
root.note: Modern C++ encodes optionality, sum types, qualified callables, and checked formatting directly in types.

children.label: std::optional values
children.note: Stores T inline plus an engaged boolean with zero heap allocation.

children.label: Checked vs unchecked access
children.note: Calling value() throws bad_optional_access while operator* assumes engagement.

children.label: C++23 monadic ops
children.note: and_then, transform, and or_else chain optional steps cleanly.

children.label: Flat error pipelines
children.note: Monadic combinators forward nullopt cleanly without nested conditional branches.

children.label: std::variant sum types
children.note: Discriminated union sized to the largest alternative plus an active index.

children.label: overloaded and std::visit
children.note: Variadic lambda inheritance enforces exhaustive compile-time dispatch across alternatives.

children.label: Avoid catch-all arms
children.note: Skipping generic auto lambdas preserves compiler errors on new alternatives.

children.label: valueless_by_exception
children.note: Occurs only if type-changing assignment throws after destroying the old alternative.

children.label: std::any open erasure
children.note: Type-erased container storing any CopyConstructible value via SBO or heap.

children.label: any_cast pointer vs value
children.note: Pointer any_cast returns nullptr on mismatch while value cast throws bad_any_cast.

children.label: Callable wrappers
children.note: Type-erased invokables differ sharply in copyability and const propagation.

children.label: std::function pitfalls
children.note: Requires CopyConstructible targets and breaks const correctness on mutable lambdas.

children.label: move_only_function
children.note: C++23 wrapper supports unique_ptr captures and honors const and noexcept qualifiers.

children.label: No empty-call overhead
children.note: Calling an empty move_only_function is UB, removing branches and RTTI.

children.label: std::format and std::print
children.note: Type-safe formatting checked at compile time with zero stream state.

children.label: consteval format_string
children.note: Rejects mismatched placeholders at compile time; dynamic strings require std::vformat.

children.label: Lvalues in make_format_args
children.note: Defect report P2905R2 restricts make_format_args to lvalues to avoid dangling.

children.label: Custom std::formatter
children.note: Specialize parse and format to integrate user types and C++23 std::println.
